reasons: The cited paragraph (p0047) contains a pricing-parity undertaking running solely in our favour: TrueLink commits that Hosting Services rates 'will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party', plus a one-year price freeze — squarely the Vendor-granted MFN the rule welcomes.
No obligation is imposed on Client to extend TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers, so the rule's flag condition is not triggered.

Consistent with the claimed compliant status and the rule's redline guidance ('keep any Vendor-granted MFN'), the redline is unchanged from the original and no counterparty comment is proposed — the expected output for a compliant finding.
Deterministic checks are empty and the rendered text matches the original character-for-character, confirming no unintended edits.
